header.notifyFailedTitle: A notice to the client was not delivered
header.notifyFailedTail: . Reach them through another channel before relying on email.
header.notePlaceholder: E.g.: closed by phone, paid at the counter.
header.archiveConfirm: Archive {ref}? It leaves the work queues and only an administrator can reopen it.
header.messageLabel: Message to the client · sent as written
header.messagePlaceholder: TAP moved flight TP1553 on 06/09 from 14:20 to 17:05. The Lisbon connection stays, with a 2h10 layover. No action needed — if you prefer another date, let us know.
header.messageHint: It is logged with your name and the time, and shows up as an alert on the client's link.

datesLock.issued: Case issued: changing dates is a reissue, and goes through the airline.
datesLock.paid: The client has already paid. Talk to them before touching the dates.

proposals.emptyNote: No proposal published yet. It is put together in the Proposals tab — itinerary, price and a preview of the card the client will see — and the client only sees the result once you publish.
proposals.viewAsClient: View as the client sees it

pax.none: The client has not submitted the passports yet.

warnings.passportShort: P{n} has a passport valid only until {date} — less than 6 months after return.
warnings.accents: P{n} has accents in the name ({name}) — the ticket needs the unaccented version.
warnings.none: No automatic warnings: expiry dates and names pass the checks.

fareAge.title: Changes fare type before departure:
fareAge.lineStart: {tag} {name} turns {turns} before {date} — on the travel date they are already
fareAge.adultTail: The child fare is not valid for this flight.
fareAge.seatTail: They now need their own seat.

com.drifted: The stored status of one of these links does not match the case status. What is shown above is the case's, which is the one that counts. The log line says when they diverged.
com.noneSent: No notice has gone out for this case yet.

log.nothingDeleted: Nothing is deleted. Every event in the case leaves a line, with who caused it.

dates.title: Route and dates
dates.subtitle: dates come from the request and can be edited
dates.routeNote: Origin and destination cannot be edited by any back-office role: a different route is a different request. Trip type:
dates.reasonPlaceholder: What happened, in the sentence the client will read. E.g.: there are no economy seats on the 14th; the first date with seats is the 16th.
dates.reasonHint: This sentence goes in the email to the client and stays in the case log. An already published proposal goes back to draft in a new revision.
dates.invalidRange: The return cannot be before the outbound.
dates.save: Save dates and notify the client
dates.reasonMissing: Write the reason to be able to save.

freeze.title: Chosen flight · frozen
freeze.subtitle: payment stage
freeze.frozenBody: The case has reached payment: the price the client sees is this offer's, and the amount to charge was calculated from it. Editing the itinerary here would change the trip underneath a payment in progress.
freeze.issued: The case is issued. Changing flight is a reissue and goes through the airline — not through this screen.
freeze.paid: The client has already paid. From here a flight change is a refund or a change with the airline, and neither is done with a button that says “go back”.
freeze.open: Go back a step and change flight
freeze.openHint: undoes the choice, closes the payment link, opens a revision and notifies the client
freeze.reasonPlaceholder: The airline no longer has seats in this fare and the alternative leaves two hours later. We will send you a new proposal.
freeze.reasonHint: This sentence goes to the client by email and WhatsApp, and stays in the case log.
freeze.submit: Go back a step and notify the client

ticket.title: Ticket builder
ticket.noOffer: The client has not chosen an offer yet. Issuance details belong to the chosen offer, so they only appear after it.
ticket.intro: What is here does not change the proposal the client read — not the price, the times or the route. These are the fields the ticket needs and the proposal did not.
ticket.refundHint: The fine print. Whether it is refundable or not is decided in the proposal.
ticket.refundPlaceholder: Refund up to 24 h before, with a fee
ticket.noSegments: This offer has no saved segments. Without them there are no terminals or booking class to fill in.
ticket.issuedNote: The case is already issued. Changing these fields now does not change the ticket the airline issued — that is a reissue, and goes through the airline.

events.pay_instructions_sent: Payment instructions sent to the client
events.flight_unfrozen: Went back a step: the chosen flight was unfrozen
events.dates_proposed: New dates proposed to the client
events.pay_method_chosen: The client chose how to pay
events.research_requested: Client asked for a new search
events.dates_changed_in_offer: Date different from the requested one, confirmed in the proposal
